text.description_html:
Weslock 7680/7602, Double Cylinder Wiltshire Handleset

Easy to install, the Wiltshire Entryset will fit door thicknesses from 1-3/4 inches to 2 inches. It will adjust to fit doors with backsets of 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches. A double cylinder handleset, the deadbolt is operated by a key from both the exterior and the interior; while the latchbolt underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior. Double cylinder entry sets are most often used on doors located near windows. An ANSI rated grade 2 lock, this 19-1/4 inch outside trim handleset made by Weslock not only looks fantastic, it is made with the attention to quality Weslock is known for. The Wiltshire Arched Handleset will be sure to make an impression. The beveled edges paired with the curved handle are a picture of elegance and subtle beauty. The Wiltshire handleset will add a touch of simple richness to your doors.

Double Cylinder Handleset: The deadbolt is key operated from both the interior and the exterior while the latch underneath the deadbolt is operated by a turn knob/lever from the interior and a thumbpiece from the exterior.

Also available matching:
Wiltshire Single Cylinder Handleset
Wiltshire Dummy Handleset

This traditionally styled handleset is from the Weslock Molten Bronze Collection which features easy installation. It has lifetime mechanical and finish warranties and meet ANSI grade 2 lock standards.

Features of the Wiltshire Weslock Double Cylinder Handleset:

  • Material: solid molten bronze.
  • Meets ANSI A 156.2 grade 2 lock standards.
  • 5-pin cylinder.
  • 1 inch throw deadbolt with two hardened steel rollers to prevent sawing.
  • Fits standard doors preparations with either 1-5/8" or 2-1/8" top and 2-1/8" bottom cross holes and 1" edge hole and a 5-1/2" center to center cross hole spacing.
  • Manufacturer Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • Manufacturer Limited 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Weslock Molten Wiltshire Double Cylinder Handleset:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Exterior Length: 19-1/4"
  • Exterior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Exterior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Length: 18-1/2"
  • Interior Width: 2-3/4"
  • Interior Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/4" to 2"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" with removable faceplates.

The inside trim will match the handleset's finish.
